risk: A client that disconnects after streaming provider work starts can leave the session gate occupied until the upstream stream ends or times out. A newer same-session request is head-of-line blocked even though the original client is gone. This can stall autonomous continuation while doing useless provider work.

candidate_contract.stream_downstream_close: terminate/destroy current upstream stream and resolve the guarded pipe promptly
candidate_contract.tool_call_safety_before_accept: withheld tool calls must never be released or checkpointed solely because of disconnect
candidate_contract.tool_call_safety_after_accept: already durably accepted pending tool calls remain pending and must block unsafe continuation
candidate_contract.provider_account_policy: client disconnect is local cancellation, not provider/account failure; do not cool or rotate an account for it
candidate_contract.same_session_gate: release after local cancellation so a later same-session request can re-read durable state

limits: No real accounts, secrets, Windows or production.
